metadata.title: PsychonautWiki Journal & FreeODwiki 综合中英文药典与拼音检索词典
metadata.description: 经权威消歧清洗的中英文药典，包含商品名、民间黑话、拼音缩写及剂量时效全量参数。

common.description_en: Common drugs are those which are well known and widely used among the drug community. This doesn't necessarily mean they are safe, but it usually comes with a longer relative history of use in humans with which to establish a safety profile.
common.description_zh: 在物质社群中广为人知且广泛使用的常见物质。这并不意味着它们绝对安全，但其相对较长的人类使用历史提供了较为明确的安全参考数据。

psychedelic.description_en: Psychedelics are drugs which alter the perception, causing a number of mental effects which manifest in many forms including altered states of consciousness, visual or tactile effects.
psychedelic.description_zh: 能够改变感知、引发意识状态改变、产生视觉或触觉等感知体验的精神活性物质。

stimulant.description_en: Stimulants excite the nervous system and increase physiological function.
stimulant.description_zh: 能够兴奋中枢神经系统并提高生理功能的物质。

entactogen.description_en: Entactogens (also known as empathogens) are a class of psychoactive substances that produce distinctive emotional and social effects similar to those of MDMA.
entactogen.description_zh: 又称放心剂（Empathogens），能产生类似 MDMA 的独特情感连接与社交亲和效应的一类精神活性物质。

depressant.description_en: Depressants are drugs which reduce arousal and stimulation in the user, characterised by a depressing of mental and physical functions.
depressant.description_zh: 能够降低中枢神经觉醒度与兴奋性、减缓精神与身体机能的物质。

opioid.description_en: Opioids are pain-killing depressants which may also cause euphoria.
opioid.description_zh: 具有镇痛和欣快作用的中枢神经抑制性物质。

habit-forming.description_en: These drugs pose a higher risk of causing habit forming behaviour, take particular care with the amount and frequency they are taken.
habit-forming.description_zh: 具有较高成瘾性与依赖性风险的物质，需特别警惕使用频率与剂量。

research-chemical.description_en: Research chemicals are drugs with relatively little history of human use, and thus particular care should be taken if choosing to ingest them.
research-chemical.description_zh: 人类使用历史相对较短、潜在毒性与长期风险尚不完全明确的策划药/新精神活性物质（RC）。

tentative.description_en: Tentative means that there is not much reliable information about it. This is often because the drug is very new. Information listed under these drugs should not be entirely trusted.
tentative.description_zh: 缺乏足够可靠临床研究或实验报告的暂定性信息，需谨慎参考。

dissociative.description_en: Dissociatives are mostly NMDA receptor antagonists, these substances are hallucinogenic but different than psychedelics. As per the name, these substances create a distance between the user and reality.
dissociative.description_zh: 多为 NMDA 受体拮抗剂，能阻断感知信号向意识传递，产生身心分离、知觉剥离与幻觉效应。

benzodiazepine.description_en: Benzodiazepines are generally hypnotic or anxiolytic depressant drugs.
benzodiazepine.description_zh: 具有镇静催眠、抗焦虑、抗惊厥和肌肉松弛作用的中枢抑制性药物（BZD）。

cannabinoid.description_en: A cannabinoid is one of a class of diverse chemical compounds that act on cannabinoid receptors on cells that alter neurotransmitter functioning in the brain.
cannabinoid.description_zh: 作用于机体大麻素受体（CB1/CB2）的一类多样化化学化合物家族。

nootropic.description_en: Nootropics (also referred to as smart drugs, neuro enhancers, and cognitive enhancers) are substances that purportedly improve cognitive functions such as memory, motivation, attention, and concentration, in healthy individuals.
nootropic.description_zh: 又称聪明药或认知增强剂，旨在改善记忆、注意力和学习等认知功能的物质。

deliriant.description_en: Deliriants are considered to be true hallucinogens, because the visuals they produce are hard or impossible to tell apart from reality; they are also known for negative physical effects.
deliriant.description_zh: 能诱发真正谵妄状态的致幻物质，其产生的幻觉与现实难以区分，常伴有意识模糊与遗忘。

barbiturate.description_en: Barbiturates (also known as barbs and barbies) are a class of psychoactive substances that act as depressants of the central nervous system. They produce a variety of sedative-hypnotic effects including sedation, anxiety suppression, muscle relaxation, and seizure suppression when administered.
barbiturate.description_zh: 作为中枢抑制剂的一类古老镇静药物，过量致死风险极高，现已大多被苯二氮䓬类取代。

eugeroic.description_en: Eugeroics, also known as wakefulness-promoting agents and wakefulness-promoting drugs, are a class of psychoactive substances that promote wakefulness and alertness. The best-known member of this class is modafinil.
eugeroic.description_zh: 又称清醒促进剂，能显著提高警觉度和对抗嗜睡，且不产生传统兴奋剂那样的过度亢奋。

hallucinogen.description_en: Hallucinogens are a class of psychoactive substances that produce powerful alterations in perception, mood, and various cognitive processes. Hallucinogens can be classified into psychedelics, dissociatives and deliriants
hallucinogen.description_zh: 能够引起知觉、思想和感觉深刻改变的精神活性物质大类（涵盖致幻剂、解离剂和谵妄剂）。

oneirogen.description_en: Oneirogen describes a wide array of psychoactive plants and chemicals ranging from normal dream enhancers to intense dissociative or deliriant drugs.
oneirogen.description_zh: 能够诱发、增强梦境或促进清醒梦（Lucid Dream）的植物与化学物质。

antipsychotic.description_en: Antipsychotics (also known as neuroleptics or major tranquilizers) are a class of psychiatric medication primarily used to manage psychosis (including delusions, hallucinations, or disordered thought), particularly in schizophrenia and bipolar disorder.
antipsychotic.description_zh: 又称神经阻滞剂，用于治疗精神分裂症、双相情感障碍及严重躁狂的精神科处方药物。

antidepressant.description_en: Antidepressants are a class of psychoactive substances that are prescribed to treat psychiatric disorders, most commonly major depressive disorder and some forms of anxiety disorders.
antidepressant.description_zh: 用于治疗抑郁症、焦虑症等情感障碍的精神科药物大类。

hypnotic.description_en: Hypnotics, or soporifics, are a class of drugs which promote and induce sleep. They are the opposite of eugeroics which promote wakefulness. They are commonly distributed in the form of pharmaceutical drugs prescribed to treat insomnia.
hypnotic.description_zh: 主要用于促进和诱导睡眠、治疗严重失眠的药物类别。
